climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A Friuli-Venezia Giulia DOC in Udine province, around Latisana and Lignano Sabbiadoro. Its rules allow still and sparkling wine. The region grows mostly Pinot Gris (29%), then Glera (25%) and Merlot (8%).
